listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom (nxport)
listing.summary: An experimental nxport Switch builder for The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom, using an Apple Silicon NVN compatibility layer with game-specific support. The project reports iOS/macOS testing, with rendering flicker, terrain-normal defects and Rauru audio problems. The exact tested version is unconfirmed. There is no release package: clone and build nxport-builder, choose this game’s profile and the Mac or iOS target, then build a local app or IPA. You and the project manage preparation and rebuilding. Use your own extracted ExeFS/RomFS/Logo. Exact accepted version, region and title ID are unconfirmed. Windows and Linux players are unconfirmed. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
